Container.Name: nuvira-server
Container.Overview: NuviraHub signalling and relay server. Forward UDP 21116 (and TCP 21116 for the WebSocket fallback) from the router to this container.

Config.Name: Port (UDP)
Config.Description: Signalling and relay (QUIC). Forward it on the router.

Config.Name: Port (TCP)
Config.Description: WebSocket fallback for networks that block UDP. Forward it on the router.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, server certificate and address book key. Back up the whole folder.

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: First address book administrator, created only if no account exists yet.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: At least 8 characters. Empty: a random password is written once to the log. Used only at the first start.

Config.Name: WebSocket listen
Config.Description: TCP address of the WebSocket fallback; off to disable it.
